name: C C Land Holdings Limited
summary: C C Land Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the investment and development of properties in the United Kingdom and Hong Kong. The company operates through two segments: Property Development and Investment; and Treasury Investment. The Property development and investment segment offers development and investment of properties. The Treasury investment segment provides investments in securities and notes receivable, and provision of financial services. The company is involved in money lending; corporate management; treasury investment and management; and investment management activities.
